Summary: MFA code rejection loop on primary admin account
Description: User John Doe (john.doe@acme.com) enters correct password and TOTP code from authenticator app, but system repeatedly displays 'Invalid MFA Token (ERR-401)' and locks out user.
Internal Notes: Investigated server time drift on auth cluster node auth-prod-02. Clock drift of 45 seconds caused TOTP window mismatch. Resynced NTP service.
Customer Response: NTP clock drift on auth node resolved. User successfully authenticated after manual lockout clearance.
Resolution: Resynced NTP service on auth-prod-02 and cleared user lockout threshold in database.
Escalation Decision: Escalated to Tier 2 System Operations for node resynchronization.

Summary: Newly provisioned dispatch manager lacks role permissions
Description: User Sarah Connor (s.connor@apexlogistics.com) was assigned 'Dispatch Manager' role in portal but receives '403 Forbidden - Access Denied' when accessing Fleet Tracking module.
Internal Notes: Checked `user_roles` table in replica DB. Role ID 4 ('Dispatch Manager') was assigned in UI but mapping transaction failed to commit to `role_permissions` join table.
Customer Response: Database mapping updated. User Sarah Connor can now access the Fleet Tracking module.
Resolution: Re-executed permission sync script via admin console and verified RBAC table entries.
Escalation Decision: Resolved at Tier 1 after diagnostic check with Tier 2 template.

Summary: Q2 Expense Export crashes on CSV format selection
Description: Navigating to Analytics -> Expense Reports, selecting 'Q2 2026', and clicking 'Export as CSV' results in an uncaught 500 Internal Server Error page.
Internal Notes: Replicated issue in staging. Null values in `expense_category` column cause NullPointerException during CSV string formatting. Bug report BUG-001 logged for Tier 3 Engineering.
Customer Response: Issue identified as a software defect handling NULL expense categories. Escalated to Engineering for hotfix deployment.
Resolution: Pending Tier 3 hotfix release v2.4.1. Workaround provided: Export as XLSX format.

Summary: Duplicate invoice records generated during monthly billing run
Description: Beacon Health account shows two identical invoices (INV-8801 and INV-8802) generated on August 1st for $4,500 each.
Internal Notes: Reviewed `account_billing` table. Billing cron worker retried job after network timeout, resulting in duplicate insert due to missing idempotency constraint.
Customer Response: Duplicate invoice INV-8802 voided and credit memo issued. Billing system updated.
Root Cause: Software Defect / Lack of Billing Idempotency
Resolution: Voided INV-8802 in database and updated billing ledger. Created engineering ticket for idempotency key implementation.
Escalation Decision: Handled by Tier 2 Application Support Analyst in coordination with Finance.

Summary: Update credit card details failing with gateway token error
Description: Admin attempting to update primary billing payment method receives error 'Gateway Response: Invalid Payment Method Token (ERR-PAY-902)'.
Internal Notes: Stripe payment gateway logs show expired authorization token. Requested customer attempt transaction in incognito window and confirm zip code mismatch.
Customer Response: Awaiting customer confirmation after instructing them to clear browser payment cache.
Resolution: Pending customer response.

Summary: Request for Webhook Notifications on Ticket Status Change
Description: Vanguard Tech IT department requests outbound webhook notifications when Northstar ticket status updates, allowing integration with their internal ServiceNow.
Internal Notes: Evaluated request against product roadmap. Feature is scheduled for Q4 release under Epic PROD-440.

Resolution: Linked ticket to Product Backlog item and notified account CSM.

Summary: SAML SSO assertion failure following Azure AD cert renewal
Description: All Crestview users attempting SSO login receive 'SAML Assertion Signature Verification Failed' error screen.
Internal Notes: Crestview IT updated their Azure AD signing certificate yesterday but failed to update the X.509 certificate string in Northstar SSO Settings portal.
Customer Response: New X.509 certificate uploaded to Northstar SSO configuration. SSO authentication restored for all users.
Resolution: Updated SAML metadata certificate in customer tenant configuration settings.
Escalation Decision: Resolved by Tier 2 Application Support Analyst.

Summary: Bulk user import tool silently drops users with hyphens in email
Description: Importing a 50-user CSV drops 4 users whose email addresses contain hyphens (e.g., mary-jane@synergymedia.com). No error message displayed.
Internal Notes: Regex validation pattern in `UserImportService.java` strictly enforces `[a-zA-0-9._]+` and rejects `-`. Engineering creating patch.
Customer Response: Identified regex parsing issue in bulk importer. Hotfix patch being verified by QA.
Resolution: In progress — patch deployment scheduled.

Summary: Transfer Primary Owner privileges from departed employee
Description: Former IT Director left company. Acme Corp requests transferring Primary Account Owner privileges to Jane Smith (j.smith@acme.com).
Internal Notes: Received signed authorization letter from Acme Corp CISO. Verified identity via phone callback. Updated `accounts` table `owner_user_id`.
Customer Response: Account ownership successfully transferred to Jane Smith following security verification.
Resolution: Executed primary owner transfer in admin portal following security sign-off.

Summary: Historical telemetry reporting missing data for July 14th
Description: Fleet utilization dashboard displays 0 miles driven and 0 active assets for entire date of July 14th, 2026.
Internal Notes: Data ingestion pipeline stalled on July 14 due to Kafka queue partition rebalance. Dead-letter queue held 14,000 unparsed telemetry events.
Customer Response: Re-driven stalled telemetry events from dead-letter queue. Dashboard now accurately displays July 14th metrics.
Root Cause: Data Pipeline / Unprocessed Kafka Dead-Letter Queue
Resolution: Executed dead-letter queue replay script and verified database record counts.
Escalation Decision: Handled in coordination with Tier 2 Data Operations.

Summary: Tiered user license seats not auto-expanding upon invitation
Description: Summit Financial purchased 100-seat tier. When attempting to invite 86th user, portal states 'Seat limit reached (85/85)'.
Internal Notes: Sales contract addendum for +15 seats was approved last Friday but sales-to-support sync trigger in CRM failed to update `accounts.max_users`.
Customer Response: Account seat cap updated from 85 to 100 in production system.
Resolution: Manually updated `max_users = 100` in database and re-triggered CRM synchronization job.

Summary: Password reset token expires instantly upon generation
Description: Users clicking 'Forgot Password' link receive email immediately, but clicking the link yields 'Password Reset Token Expired or Invalid'.
Internal Notes: Corporate email security scanner (Proofpoint) at Beacon Health pre-evaluates all incoming links, consuming the one-time token before user clicks.
Customer Response: Advised customer IT team to add Northstar password reset domain to Proofpoint link-rewriting bypass list.
Resolution: Configured reset link tokens to require POST confirmation step instead of GET single-use consumption.
Escalation Decision: Escalated to Tier 2 Application Support Analyst.

Summary: Inventory sync widget displays blank white screen on Safari browser
Description: Opening the Inventory Sync dashboard on macOS Safari 17.4 results in a blank white container, while working fine on Chrome.
Internal Notes: Console log shows `SyntaxError: Safari unsupported ECMAScript private field syntax (#privateMethod)` in bundled React JS asset.
Customer Response: Identified Webpack JS transpilation incompatibility with Safari 17.4. Engineering building babel polyfill fix.
Resolution: In progress — pending frontend hotfix release.

Summary: Resource allocation report shows negative hour balances
Description: Project Managers viewing August resource allocation report see -14.5 hours for employee Mark Davis.
Internal Notes: Timecard entry table allowed overlapping PTO and active project hours due to missing client-side validation logic during time import.
Customer Response: Corrected corrupted timecard entry in database. Timecard validation constraint patch submitted.
Resolution: Executed SQL fix script to adjust conflicting time records and updated reporting view.
Escalation Decision: Resolved by Tier 2 Application Support Analyst.

Summary: Custom branding options for tenant client portal
Description: Crestview requests capability to upload custom logo and define primary CSS hex colors for client-facing document portal.
Internal Notes: Logged enhancement request in Jira Product Discovery board under ID JPD-112.
Customer Response: Feature request logged and sent to UX/Product design team for consideration.
Resolution: Open — logged in Product Backlog.

Summary: Bulk permission revoking failed midway through execution
Description: Admin attempted to remove 'Editor' role from 30 contractors. Script timed out after 12 users, leaving 18 contractors with active access.
Internal Notes: Batch transaction hit 30-second API gateway execution limit. Ran manual SQL script to complete revocation for remaining 18 users.
Customer Response: Completed permission revocation for all 18 remaining contractor accounts.
Resolution: Executed batch permission removal in backend database and verified audit log.
Escalation Decision: Resolved at Tier 1 Support Lead level.

Summary: Session timeout enforcing logout every 5 minutes unexpectedly
Description: Warehouse supervisors report being logged out of handheld browser terminals every 5 minutes despite setting timeout to 8 hours.
Internal Notes: Cookie security flag `SameSite=Strict` caused session cookie invalidation when handheld devices roamed between Wi-Fi access points.
Customer Response: Session cookie policy adjusted to `SameSite=Lax` for mobile user agent profile.
Resolution: Updated session configuration settings in application control panel.
Escalation Decision: Handled by Tier 1 Support in consultation with Tier 2 Lead.

Summary: Tax exempt certificate not reflecting on automated invoice
Description: Acme Corp submitted sales tax exemption certificate, but August invoice INV-9021 included $380 state sales tax.
Internal Notes: Tax exemption flag `is_tax_exempt` was set to true in customer profile, but AvaTax integration cached old taxable status.
Customer Response: Flushed AvaTax integration cache and reissued corrected tax-exempt invoice INV-9021-REV.
Resolution: Reissued invoice without sales tax and verified AvaTax tax-exempt entity code.

Summary: Patient scheduling calendar shifts appointments by 1 hour (DST issue)
Description: Appointments booked for November 2026 display 1 hour earlier on calendar view due to incorrect UTC offset calculation.
Internal Notes: Date library `date-fns` was called without explicit IANA timezone string, causing local browser DST parsing discrepancy.
Customer Response: Identified timezone parsing bug during Daylight Saving Time transition window. Patch under development.
Resolution: In progress — engineering applying explicit IANA timezone parsing.

Summary: GL Account Code mapping corrupted after nightly sync
Description: General Ledger account codes shifted by 1 column, mapping Revenue to Expense categories in executive dashboard.
Internal Notes: Nightly CSV ingestion pipeline encountered unexpected extra comma in customer department name field, misaligning array index mapping.
Customer Response: Corrected CSV parser quote-escaping rules and restored valid GL account mapping in database.
Root Cause: Data Ingestion / Unescaped Delimiter In Input Data
Resolution: Ran database correction script and deployed RFC-4180 compliant CSV parsing rule.
Escalation Decision: Resolved by Tier 2 Application Support Analyst.

Summary: Active Directory LDAP sync dropping new store manager credentials
Description: Store managers added to local Active Directory group `Northstar-Users` cannot log in via LDAP integration.
Internal Notes: LDAP base DN query path exceeded 256 character length limit in Northstar configuration settings.
Customer Response: Shortened LDAP OU search path in application configuration settings. Sync tested successfully.
Root Cause: Application Configuration / LDAP Search Path Constraint
Resolution: Updated LDAP configuration string and executed manual directory sync.

Summary: HIPAA Audit Trail Export with automated scheduled delivery

Resolution: Open — logged in Product Backlog.

Summary: Property document upload button disabled for guest tenant accounts
Description: Guest tenant role should have upload rights to 'Maintenance Photos' folder, but button remains permanently disabled.
Internal Notes: Frontend UI component evaluated `user.is_guest` instead of `permission.can_upload_photos`. Fixed in hotfix v2.3.9.
Customer Response: Hotfix v2.3.9 deployed. Guest tenant upload button now functions correctly.
Resolution: Deployed frontend hotfix v2.3.9.
Escalation Decision: Resolved by Tier 1 in coordination with Release Management.

Summary: API Key generation tool throws 500 error for non-superadmin users
Description: Developer role users attempting to generate API keys receive modal error 'Internal Server Error (500)'.
Internal Notes: Backend endpoint tried to write to `api_keys_audit` table without passing `created_by` user ID for non-superadmins.
Customer Response: Patched backend API controller to properly record creator user ID for developer role API keys.
Root Cause: Software Defect / Missing Foreign Key Parameter in API Handler
Resolution: Hotfix applied to backend API service and verified with Vanguard Tech developers.
Escalation Decision: Resolved by Tier 2 Application Support Analyst.

Summary: Analytics storage quota warning triggered in error
Description: Synergy Media account received alert 'Analytics storage at 98% capacity', but actual usage displays 42 GB out of 500 GB.
Internal Notes: Quota alert cron job queried `temp_analytics_scratch` table size instead of `production_analytics_storage` size.
Customer Response: Corrected cron query targeting analytics storage calculations. Quota alert cleared.
Root Cause: Application Logic / Misconfigured Cron Quota Query
Resolution: Updated storage calculation script in production cron job.
